title: unified-rollouts-canary-shadow-rollback-improvements
author: Priya Kapoor
body: Motivation: hardening the Unified Rollouts autorollback behavior for canary + shadow traffic scenarios. This PR tightens metric matching, adds hysteresis to avoidance of flapping rollbacks, and improves observability and e2e coverage. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce compositeMetricEvaluator that supports weighted combination of latency/error/accuracy metrics with configurable thresholds per rollout stage. 2) Add rollbackHysteresis window and minStabilityDuration to avoid immediate rollbacks on transient spikes. 3) Extend shadow traffic probing to surface per-model metric deltas and add telemetry events for 'probe_start'/'probe_end'/'quarantine_enter'/'quarantine_exit'. 4) Add canaryProgressionPolicy to allow stepwise weight increases with safety gates and optional manual approval checkpoint. 5) E2E tests and integration test harness updates for staged shadow/canary scenarios. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked - ENG-2142 - [x] Unit tests for compositeMetricEvaluator - [x] Integration tests for rollback hysteresis - [x] Observability dashboards and alerts - [x] Docs update (rollouts guide) - [x] Backwards-compatible: default behavior unchanged without config. Release notes: improved stability for canary+shadow rollouts, reduced false-positive rollbacks, new rollout config knobs.

review_comments: Alex Martinez: Overall looks good — can you clarify the default hysteresis window and explain why 30s was chosen?
Priya Kapoor: Answered — used 30s as tradeoff after load tests (see comments) and made it configurable via minStabilityDuration. Added benchmark note to PR body.
Ming Zhao: We should avoid double-counting shadow vs canary traffic in composite metrics. Suggest using separate metric streams and a weighted merge.
Priya Kapoor: Updated compositeMetricEvaluator to accept separate streams and explicit weights. Added unit test for stream merging.
Samir Patel: CI flaked on e2e in first run, re-ran and passing now. Approve pending a small lint fix.
ci_checks: ci/integration-e2e: pass (flaky on first run, rerun succeeded)
release_notes: Stability improvements for canary+shadow rollouts: new composite metrics, rollback hysteresis and progression policy to reduce false-positive rollbacks; added telemetry for probe lifecycle; new e2e tests.
notes_on_migration: Config migration helper added: rollout.canaryProgressionPolicy defaults to legacy behavior when omitted. No action required for existing rollout configs.
testing_notes: Load-tested on staging with synthetic traffic; author ran 10k request/min scenarios and validated no increased rollback rate vs baseline. E2E tests cover quarantine and manual-approval paths.
